cover: Cut your cloud bill without a risky cutover

slides.title: Read the invoice first
slides.body: The big lines are usually egress, servers sized for a rare peak, and services that each bill separately.

slides.title: Sort every workload
slides.body: Each one moves as it is, needs a bridge, or stays where it is.

slides.title: Be honest about what stays
slides.body: GPU work, stateful services and hard-won compliance boundaries are often best left alone.

slides.title: Move one route at a time
slides.body: Behind the DNS you already control, so users keep the same URLs throughout.

slides.title: Start with the easy savings
slides.body: File storage is often first: moving it removes egress fees without touching application code.
